mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
diaz: Díaz — Díaz (patronymic 'son of Diego'; Ruy Diaz, the Cid's name, = Ruy Díaz; same as díaz, here without accent)
odredes: oír — you will hear (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = oiréis; the minstrel's aside to his listeners)
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que)
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
comde: conde — count (Pidal's co[m]de; al comde de Barçilona 'to the count of Barcelona'; = conde)
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
vino: vino — wine (noun); also venir — he came (strong preterite 3rd sg.; por en vino a aquesto, 'that is how he came to this pass')
si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda)
digo: dezir — I say (present 1st sg.; yo non vos digo nada 'I say nothing to you'; = digo)
fiziéredes: fazer — (if) you do, should do (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hiciereis)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain)
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men')
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection')
rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
dexar: dexar — to leave (infinitive; = dejar; split future dexar las ha = las dejará)
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later'
fasta: fasta — until, as far as (= hasta)
terçer: terçero — third (apocopated before a noun; al terçer día 'on the third day'; = tercer)
acordar: acordar — to take counsel, agree (infinitive; tornós a acordar 'he set to take counsel'; = acordar)
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
fazer: fazer — to make, do, dig (infinitive; mandó fazer 'ordered made'; = hacer)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
algo: algo — something; the poem's discreet word for money, wealth
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain)
cristianos: cristiano — Christian(s) (masc. pl.); moros nin cristianos / cristianos alone idiomatically = 'anyone at all'
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · also 'let it be' as a hortatory subjunctive (aquí sea la batalla 'let the battle be here')
pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront')
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
dalgo: de + algo — of something; fija dalgo 'daughter of something', well-born (= hidalga)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos)
mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping' · a mano 'by hand, hand-picked' (escollechos a mano 'chosen by hand')
yas: ya + se — already … themselves (ya + reflexive se cut to s; yas mueven 'they are already moving'; = ya se)
iva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg.; iva posar 'was going to halt'; = iba)
alegrando: alegrar — rejoicing, cheering (gerund; alegrando se va 'goes along rejoicing'; = alegrándose)
avedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, -edes; perfect auxiliary with a participle, me avedes mandado 'you have granted me'; = habéis)
fablado: fablar — spoken (past part.; quando esto ovo fablado 'when he had said this'; = hablado)
quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar)
seré: seer — I shall be (future 1st sg. of ser)
dent: dent — of it, thereof (de + ent, a form of ende 'thence'; non nos darán dent nada 'they will give us none of it'; = de ello) · also dent — from there, thence (dent corre mio Çid a Huesa 'from there the Çid raids to Huesa'; = de allí)
dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses'
he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he)
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
sabet: saber — know, mark you (imperative 2nd pl., sabed; sabet = sabed; epic tag addressed to the audience)
dinero: dinero — penny (a small coin, the unit of smallest denomination)
malo: malo — bad; un dinero malo, 'one bad penny' — a debased coin, naming the smallest thing worth mentioning
huebos: huebos — need (Latin opus); huebos (me) ser/aver = 'to have need (of)'
me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
andan: andar — they go about, range (present 3rd pl.; = andan)
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision)
hemos: aver — we will/shall (1st pl. future auxiliary; restored by Pidal in the split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos)
abremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; = habremos)
mientra: mientra — while, as long as (= mientras)
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing')
ira: ira — wrath; en ira del rey = to be formally cast into the king's disgrace and exile, a legal idiom, not a mere figure of speech
tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
echado: echar — cast out, exiled (past part.; = echado)
conde: conde — count (noun; el conde don Remont 'Count Remont'; = conde)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding
delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante)
le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him')
avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié)
dados: dar — given, paid (past part. masc. pl.; dados foron 'were paid'; = dados)
va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing' · ir + infinitive 'goes to' (la manol va besar 'goes to kiss his hand', el Duero va passar 'goes to cross the Duero') · also va — 'there is, goes on' impersonal (¡Qué priessa va en los moros! 'what a stir there is among the Moors!')
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also qué — how (exclamative before an adverb: qué bien pago 'how well he paid')
grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had')
ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora)
nasco: nacer — he was born (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water')
feremos: fazer — we shall make, win (future 1st pl., syncopated; feremos ganançia 'we shall make gain'; = haremos)
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
morada: morada — dwelling, stay, lodging (= morada; non i avrie morada 'one could not stay there')
no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
voluntad: voluntad — will, willingness; de voluntad e de grado, a doubled formula, 'willingly and gladly' · God's will (commo fo tu voluntad 'as was your will'); de toda voluntad 'with all one's heart'
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain')
remont: Remont — Ramón, the count of Barcelona's name in the poem (don Remont; in full Remont Verenguel; = Ramón)
somos: seer — we are (1st pl. of seer = ser)
cavalgaremos: cavalgar — we shall ride (future 1st pl.; = cabalgaremos)
fue: seer — he was (preterite 3rd sg.; en buen ora fue nado 'was born in a good hour'; = fue)
sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure'
entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together'
entrado: entrar — entered, gone in (past part.; f[o] entrado = 'had gone in', a ser + participle periphrasis)
fata: fata — until, as far as (variant of fasta; = hasta)
cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year') · also de cabo — 'again, anew' (que los cometamos de cabo 'that we attack them again'; = de nuevo) · also a cabo de — at the end of, after (a cabo de tres sedmanas 'after three weeks')
albergada: albergada — encampment, camp (noun from albergar 'to lodge'; Pidal 'campamento'; esta albergada 'this camp'; = campamento)
castellano: castellano — Castilian, of Castile (el Castellano, epithet of Alfonso as king of Castile; = castellano) · also el Castellano — an epithet of the Cid himself (mio Çid Roy Díaz el Castellano 'the Castilian')
ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
ides: ir — you go (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = vais)
guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of' · a vuestra guisa 'as you see fit, in your own way' (prended a vuestra guisa 'take as you please')
dexado: dexar — left, left behind (past part.; = dejado)
quisiéredes: querer — you shall wish (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; si la quisiéredes 'if you wish it'; = quisiereis, tense obsolete)
buscar: buscar — to seek (infinitive; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us', infinitive + clitic + auxiliary, split future/conditional; = buscar)
fazedme: fazer + me — do for me (2nd pl. imperative fazed + enclitic me; fazedme mandado 'send me word'; = hacedme)
antes: antes — before; antes de 'before' · also antes que — 'before' (conjunction; antes quel prendan 'before they take him') · also antes — 'rather' (antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body')
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me')
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde)
sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
salvo: salvo — safety, safe-keeping (noun; en vuestro salvo 'in your safe keeping') · also adjective, safe, saved (por end es salvo de mal 'for that reason he is saved from evil')
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar)
tornando: tornar — turning (gerund; la cabeça tornando va 'he goes turning his head'; = tornando)
cabeça: cabeça — head (= cabeza; ç sounded ts)
caboso: caboso — accomplished, excellent (adj., also used alone as a noun, 'the excellent one')
ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord')
fizo: fazer — he made, did, caused (strong preterite 3rd sg.; fizo posar 'he made (them) halt'; = hizo)
alguandre: alguandre — ever, at any time (adverb; nunqua ... alguandre 'never ... ever'; no modern equivalent, closest alguna vez)
ido: ir — gone (past part.; ser + ido as perfect of a verb of motion: ido es a Castiella 'he has gone to Castile'; = ido)
tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s) · also tornarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin' (tornós a sonrisar 'he broke into a smile', perhaps 'smiled again'; the Cid the subject)
bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
mesnadas: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (pl.; = mesnadas)
ganançia: ganançia — gain, profit, interest (= ganancia) · also booty, spoils of war (de ganançia 'as booty'; feremos grand ganançia 'we shall take great spoils')
han: aver — they have (present 3rd pl.; = han); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (seervos han = os serán) · also han a + inf. 'they have to, are bound to' (mandado de so señor todo lo han a far); 'they hold, possess' (que moros las han)
fecha: fazer — made, done (past part. fem. of fazer = hacer; = hecha, note f-)
son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do'
